faq.startTitle: How do I start a practice session?
faq.startBody: Open the Interview tab and tap Start Voice Mode. Allow microphone access when your browser asks. The AI interviewer will greet you and wait for your response.
faq.micBody: Check that your browser has microphone permission, then open Application Settings > Microphone & Audio Check to test your device. Close other apps using the microphone, and make sure the right input device is selected.
faq.bluetoothTitle: Can I use a Bluetooth headset?
faq.bluetoothBody: Yes. Connect your headset to your device, then open Application Settings > Microphone & Audio Check. Select it as both the microphone and speaker, and run the tests.
faq.languageTitle: How do I change the language?
faq.languageBody: Open Application Settings and choose a language under Language. The interface and AI interviewer will use your selection.
faq.audioBody: No. Speech is transcribed on your device to power the conversation. We don't store or send recordings of your voice.
faq.subscriptionTitle: How do I manage my subscription?
faq.subscriptionBody: Open the menu and choose Manage Subscription. Billing management is not available yet, but your current plan is shown there.
faq.accountTitle: How do I delete my account?
faq.accountBody: Open Account Settings and select Delete Account. Account deletion is permanent and removes your practice data.
faq.studyTitle: Where can I find official study materials?
faq.studyBody: Open the Study tab to browse the USCIS Knowledge Bank and other learning resources.
